answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 15 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in whisper, verified in opal, and canyon names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That is 1235 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
